papers.title: Balancing benefit and burden: rethinking post-polypectomy colonoscopy surveillance strategies
papers.authors: IJspeert J, Bretthauer M, Jover R, Dekker E, Dutch colonoscopy surveillance working group
papers.abstract: Post-polypectomy colonoscopy surveillance is widely implemented to reduce colorectal cancer incidence and mortality, yet increasing evidence raises concerns about whether current strategies are optimally balanced in terms of benefit, burden, and resource use. At least some individuals currently classified as being high risk for post-polypectomy colorectal cancer might actually have a low absolute risk, suggesting that surveillance might be overused in this group of patients. At the same time, colonoscopy surveillance imposes considerable burden at the patient, health-care system, and societal levels, including procedural risks, costs, and pressure on endoscopy capacity. This Viewpoint critically examines the limitations underlying current post-colonoscopy surveillance strategies, including reliance on historical data with inadequate collection of quality indicators, insufficient focus on the absolute risk of colorectal cancer, and potential misclassification of patients' risk. We argue that these limitations might have led to suboptimal allocation of surveillance intensity. We advocate for a shift towards a more comprehensive risk-stratified framework, in which surveillance decisions are guided by absolute colorectal cancer risk thresholds and could incorporate less invasive triage approaches for lower-risk individuals. Overall, we propose rethinking post-polypectomy surveillance to better align clinical practice with contemporary evidence with the goal of improving patient outcomes while minimising unnecessary interventions and health-care burden.
papers.title_zh: 在效益與負擔間求取平衡：重新思考息肉切除術後大腸鏡追蹤策略
papers.abstract_zh: 息肉切除術後大腸鏡追蹤已被廣泛實施，以降低大腸直腸癌的發生率與死亡率，然而越來越多證據顯示，目前的策略在效益、負擔與資源使用之間是否達到最佳平衡令人擔憂。目前被歸類為息肉切除術後大腸直腸癌高風險的部分個案，實際上絕對風險可能偏低，這意味著這群病人的追蹤可能被過度使用。同時，大腸鏡追蹤在病人、醫療系統與社會層面都帶來相當大的負擔，包括操作風險、成本，以及對內視鏡容量的壓力。本觀點文章批判性檢視現行息肉切除術後追蹤策略的限制，包括：依賴品質指標收集不足的歷史資料、對大腸直腸癌絕對風險的關注不足，以及病人風險分類可能存在的誤判。我們認為這些限制可能導致追蹤強度分配不當。我們主張轉向更全面的風險分層架構，讓追蹤決策以絕對大腸直腸癌風險門檻為指引，並可針對較低風險族群納入較不具侵入性的分層評估方法。總體而言，我們提議重新思考息肉切除術後追蹤策略，使臨床實務更貼合當代證據，目標是在改善病人預後的同時，減少不必要的介入與醫療負擔。

papers.title: Induction and Prolonged Induction With Mirikizumab in Ulcerative Colitis-A Prospective, Real-World Study From the Sicilian Network for Inflammatory Bowel Disease (SN-IBD)
papers.authors: Costantino G, Viola A, Iuculano A, Macaluso F, Voti R, Cappello M
papers.abstract:
BACKGROUND: Mirikizumab (MIRI), an IgG4 monoclonal antibody targeting IL-23 p19, was recently licensed for ulcerative colitis (UC). Most available data come from the pivotal trials, but real-life data are scant. We aimed to evaluate the effectiveness and safety of MIRI in a real-world setting.
METHODS: UC patients from 12 centres of the SN-IBD were prospectively enrolled. The primary endpoints were clinical response, steroid-free remission (SFR), and reduction of urgency at week 12 and at week 24. As secondary endpoint, the need for prolonged induction was considered. All patients received 3 infusions at monthly intervals of 300 mg MIRI; in case of inadequate response, the induction period was prolonged. Urgency was determined by means of the Urgency Numerical Rating Scale (UNRS).
RESULTS: One hundred and five patients were included. Previous failures to 2 or more lines of advanced therapies were present in 74% of patients. At week 12, 24% of patients achieved a clinical response and 53% achieved SFR. At week 24 (n = 71), the rates were 20% and 68%, respectively. The median urgency score decreased from 6 at baseline to 2 at week 12 and to 1 at week 24 (p < 0.001, both). Prolonged induction was necessary to half of patients. Adverse events were reported in 5% of patients. Treatment failures occurred in 14 patients (13%).
CONCLUSIONS: Our real-life study confirmed the short-term effectiveness and safety of MIRI in patients with UC especially in relieving bowel urgency. The flexible induction schedule allows an additional gain in response and remission.
papers.title_zh: Mirikizumab誘導治療與延長誘導治療於潰瘍性結腸炎之應用－西西里發炎性腸道疾病網絡（SN-IBD）前瞻性真實世界研究
papers.abstract_zh: 背景：Mirikizumab（MIRI）是一種針對IL-23 p19的IgG4單株抗體，近期已獲批用於治療潰瘍性結腸炎（UC）。目前多數資料來自關鍵性臨床試驗，真實世界資料仍有限。本研究目的為評估MIRI在真實世界情境下的療效與安全性。方法：前瞻性納入來自SN-IBD 12個中心的UC患者。主要終點為第12週及第24週之臨床反應、無類固醇緩解（SFR）及急迫感之改善程度。次要終點為需要延長誘導治療之比例。所有患者接受每月一次共3劑300mg MIRI輸注；若反應不佳則延長誘導期。急迫感以急迫感數值評分量表（UNRS）評估。結果：共納入105名患者。74%患者曾對兩種或以上之進階治療失敗。第12週時，24%患者達到臨床反應，53%達到SFR。第24週時（n=71），比例分別為20%及68%。急迫感評分中位數由基線的6分降至第12週的2分及第24週的1分（p<0.001，兩者皆同）。半數患者需要延長誘導治療。5%患者發生不良事件。14名患者（13%）發生治療失敗。結論：本真實世界研究證實MIRI於UC患者之短期療效與安全性，尤其在緩解排便急迫感方面表現良好。彈性化的誘導療程可額外提升反應率與緩解率。

papers.title: Exploring associations between epidemiological risk factors and colorectal cancer in Oman: a case-control study
papers.authors: Rehman S, Shalaby A, Al-Busafi S, Chan M, Khabouri S, Al Hinai M
papers.abstract:
OBJECTIVES: To identify risk factors and examine associations between colorectal cancer (CRC) status and modifiable and non-modifiable risk factors among patients diagnosed in Oman, considering the existence and increase of incidence and prevalence of these risk factors.
DESIGN: A multicentre case-control study.
SETTING: Sultan Qaboos University Hospital and the Royal Hospital in Muscat, Oman.
PARTICIPANTS: Patients diagnosed with CRC (n=166) and controls (n=166).
OUTCOME MEASURES: A questionnaire adapted from the Colon Cancer Family Registry and other previously published studies was used to collect data on sociodemographic characteristics, modifiable and non-modifiable CRC risk factors and coexisting morbidities. Univariable and multivariable logistic regression analyses were performed to examine associations between CRC status and independent variables.
RESULTS: Multivariable analysis demonstrated significant associations between CRC status and several risk factors. Smoking was associated with a fourfold increased risk of CRC (adjusted OR (aOR): 4.35, 95% CI 2.26 to 8.36). Higher body mass index was also associated with increased CRC risk (aOR: 2.42, 95% CI 1.23 to 4.76), while individuals with a family history of CRC, including first-degree relatives (biological parents, siblings and children) and second-degree relatives (grandparents, uncles and aunts) had more than double the risk (aOR: 2.10, 95% CI 1.15 to 3.82). Also, polyps had double the risk (aOR 2.61, 95% CI 1.40 to 4.84) In addition, CRC was more common among patients with diabetes (aOR 2.70, 95% CI 1.52 to 4.80), hypertension (aOR 4.13, 95% CI 2.03 to 8.42) and inflammatory bowel disease (aOR 3.48, 95% CI 1.13 to 10.67).
CONCLUSIONS: Considering the existence of non-modifiable risk factors and the increase in incidence and prevalence of modifiable risk factors of CRC in Oman, the findings of this study underscore the need for targeted awareness initiatives, risk-based screening and early surveillance, particularly among high-risk groups. The results also support integrating smoking cessation, weight management and optimal control of chronic diseases into national CRC prevention programmes to reduce the overall CRC disease burden.
papers.title_zh: 探討阿曼流行病學風險因子與大腸直腸癌（CRC）之關聯：一項病例對照研究
papers.abstract_zh: 目的：在阿曼確診之患者中，探討CRC狀態與可修飾及不可修飾風險因子之關聯，並考量這些風險因子發生率與盛行率之存在與增加。設計：多中心病例對照研究。場域：阿曼馬斯喀特之蘇丹卡布斯大學醫院與皇家醫院。參與者：CRC患者（n=166）與對照組（n=166）。結果測量：使用改編自大腸癌家族登錄及其他先前發表研究之問卷，收集社會人口學特徵、可修飾與不可修飾之CRC風險因子及共病資料。以單變項與多變項邏輯回歸分析檢視CRC狀態與獨立變項之關聯。結果：多變項分析顯示CRC狀態與多項風險因子有顯著關聯。吸菸與CRC風險增加四倍相關（調整後OR (aOR)：4.35，95% CI 2.26至8.36）。較高身體質量指數亦與CRC風險增加相關（aOR：2.42，95% CI 1.23至4.76）；有CRC家族史者（包括一級親屬：生父母、兄弟姊妹、子女，以及二級親屬：祖父母、叔伯姑姨）風險增加逾兩倍（aOR：2.10，95% CI 1.15至3.82）。此外，息肉使風險增加兩倍（aOR 2.61，95% CI 1.40至4.84）。另外，糖尿病（aOR 2.70，95% CI 1.52至4.80）、高血壓（aOR 4.13，95% CI 2.03至8.42）及發炎性腸道疾病（aOR 3.48，95% CI 1.13至10.67）患者中CRC更為常見。結論：考量阿曼不可修飾風險因子之存在及可修飾風險因子發生率與盛行率之增加，本研究結果強調需針對高風險族群推行目標性衛教、風險導向篩檢及早期監測。研究結果亦支持將戒菸、體重管理及慢性病最佳控制納入國家CRC預防計畫，以降低整體CRC疾病負擔。

papers.title: The role of osteoprotegerin in colorectal cancer: Molecular interactions, mechanistic insights, and therapeutic implications
papers.authors: Ng C, Lyu Z, Li M, Xu L, Wang N, Zhong L
papers.abstract:
BACKGROUND: Despite advances in emerging therapies, colorectal cancer (CRC) incidence continues to rise and clinical outcomes remain suboptimal, highlighting the need for improved management strategies. One potential therapeutic target is osteoprotegerin (OPG), a glycoprotein which exhibits context-dependent functions by interacting with both Receptor Activator of Nuclear Factor Kappa-B Ligand (RANKL) to produce anti-resorption effects and TNF-related apoptosis inducing ligand (TRAIL) to promote cell survival, potentially modulating key hallmarks of CRC progression. However, its translational potential remains underexplored.
AIMS AND SCOPE: This review summarizes OPG's structure, expression, and physiological roles, followed by a comprehensive analysis of its mechanistic contributions to CRC progression. We then examine therapeutic strategies targeting OPG and its potential as a diagnostic biomarker, before concluding with perspectives on future research.
KEY FINDINGS: Present evidence suggests that circulating OPG levels are associated with prognostic factors in CRC such as overall survival and metastasis rates. However, unresolved mechanistic questions remain, particularly regarding dominant cellular sources of OPG and whether circulating OPG levels directly reflect inflammatory and/or tumor dysfunction. Clinically, OPG holds promise as a biomarker for CRC, though it may be more effectively utilized within multi-marker panels rather than as a standalone biomarker. Current research has predominantly focused on the RANKL signaling pathway, leading to development of anti-RANKL therapeutics such as Denosumab, while OPG-specific therapeutics remain underdeveloped. Collectively, future research could investigate whether compartment-specific OPG levels could serve as a biomarker for CRC and predict responses to immunotherapeutics, alongside drug repurposing of existing anti-RANKL therapeutics, and non-pharmacological strategies targeting OPG.
papers.title_zh: 骨保護素（Osteoprotegerin）在大腸直腸癌中的角色：分子交互作用、機轉洞見與治療意涵
papers.abstract_zh:
背景：儘管新興療法不斷進展，大腸直腸癌（CRC）發生率仍持續上升，臨床預後仍不理想，凸顯改善治療策略的必要性。骨保護素（OPG）是一種具有情境依賴功能的糖蛋白，可與核因子kappa-B受體活化因子配體（RANKL）交互作用產生抗骨質流失效果，亦可與TNF相關凋亡誘導配體（TRAIL）交互作用促進細胞存活，可能調節CRC進展的關鍵特徵，然而其轉譯潛力仍未充分探討。

目的與範疇：本綜述總結OPG的結構、表現與生理角色，隨後全面分析其對CRC進展的機轉貢獻。接著檢視針對OPG的治療策略及其作為診斷生物標記的潛力，最後提出未來研究方向。

主要發現：現有證據顯示循環OPG濃度與CRC的預後因子（如整體存活與轉移率）有關。然而仍存在未解決的機轉問題，特別是OPG的主要細胞來源，以及循環OPG濃度是否直接反映發炎及/或腫瘤功能異常。臨床上，OPG具有作為CRC生物標記的潛力，但可能更適合用於多標記組合中，而非單獨使用。目前研究主要聚焦於RANKL訊號路徑，已發展出如Denosumab等抗RANKL治療藥物，而OPG特異性治療藥物仍未充分開發。整體而言，未來研究可探討區室特異性OPG濃度是否可作為CRC生物標記並預測免疫治療反應，同時探討現有抗RANKL藥物的老藥新用，以及針對OPG的非藥物策略。

papers.title: Comparison of incision and drainage procedure with drainage and ligation of the intersphincteric fistula tract in the treatment of deep perianal abscess
papers.abstract: Patients with deep perianal abscess (DPA) and transsphincteric fistula typically require incision and drainage as emergency treatment. However, recurrent abscesses and fistulas are common. This study aimed to evaluate the impact of simultaneous ligation of the intersphincteric fistula tract (LIFT) on abscess recurrence, incontinence, and fistula healing. This study is a retrospective analysis of an institutional protocol and includes 111 patients divided into two groups: Group I (incision and drainage alone, n = 57) and Group II (incision and drainage combined with the LIFT procedure, n = 54). The primary endpoint was persistent fistula at 6 months, confirmed by clinical examination and magnetic resonance imaging (MRI). Secondary endpoints included abscess recurrence, Wexner incontinence score changes, and complications. Firth's penalized logistic regression, inverse probability of treatment weighting (IPTW), and log-rank analyses were performed to assess outcomes. At the 3rd month, the number of patients with persistent fistula was 16 (28.1%) in Group I, while it was 3 patients (5.6%) in Group II (P = 0.002). At the 6th month, persistent fistula was observed in 21 of 55 patients (38.2%) in Group I and 3 of 53 patients (5.7%) in Group II (P < 0.001). Firth's penalized logistic regression showed that the LIFT procedure was significantly associated with reduced fistula persistence (OR = 0.079, 95% CI 0.019-0.327, P < 0.001). A sensitivity analysis restricted to patients with MRI-confirmed transsphincteric fistula (Group I: n = 34; Group II: n = 54) confirmed these findings (59.4% vs. 5.7%, P < 0.001). IPTW-adjusted analysis yielded consistent results (weighted OR = 0.063). This study demonstrates that the LIFT procedure, when applied together with drainage, reduces the incidence of persistent fistula and shows a non-significant reduction in abscess recurrence in patients with DPA and complex anal fistula. These findings should be interpreted with caution due to the non-randomized design and require confirmation through prospective randomized controlled trials.
papers.title_zh: 深部肛周膿瘍治療：切開引流術與切開引流併括約肌間廔管結紮術（LIFT）之比較
papers.abstract_zh: 深部肛周膿瘍（DPA）合併經肛門括約肌廔管患者，通常需要緊急切開引流治療。然而，膿瘍與廔管復發相當常見。本研究旨在評估同時進行括約肌間廔管結紮術（LIFT）對膿瘍復發、失禁及廔管癒合的影響。本研究為機構治療流程之回溯性分析，共納入111名患者，分為兩組：第I組（單純切開引流，n=57）與第II組（切開引流併LIFT，n=54）。主要終點為6個月時經臨床檢查及磁共振造影（MRI）確認之持續性廔管。次要終點包括膿瘍復發、Wexner失禁評分變化及併發症。使用Firth懲罰式邏輯回歸、治療機率加權逆機率法（IPTW）及log-rank分析評估結果。第3個月時，第I組持續性廔管患者為16名（28.1%），第II組為3名（5.6%）（P=0.002）。第6個月時，第I組55名患者中21名（38.2%）出現持續性廔管，第II組53名患者中3名（5.7%）（P<0.001）。Firth懲罰式邏輯回歸顯示LIFT手術與廔管持續性降低顯著相關（OR=0.079，95% CI 0.019-0.327，P<0.001）。限於MRI確認經括約肌廔管患者之敏感性分析（第I組n=34；第II組n=54）證實此結果（59.4% vs. 5.7%，P<0.001）。IPTW調整後分析結果一致（加權OR=0.063）。本研究證實LIFT手術併同引流可降低DPA及複雜性肛門廔管患者持續性廔管發生率，並對膿瘍復發顯示無統計顯著性之下降趨勢。因非隨機分派設計，此結果應謹慎解讀，需前瞻性隨機對照試驗進一步證實。
papers.score_reason: 雖使用IPTW與Firth校正試圖降低混雜偏差，但非隨機分組使LIFT適應症選擇偏差風險極高，效果量雖大且跨多重分析一致，仍需RCT才能改變臨床決策。
papers.relevance_why: 深部肛周膿瘍合併廔管是大腸直腸外科日常常見急症，急性期是否同時處理廔管是臨床實際爭議點。

papers.action: 目前不需改變常規做法；可留意此為急性期同步LIFT的初步訊號，但因回溯性設計混雜風險高，暫不建議常規套用，待RCT證實。

papers.title: Studying When to Add Biological Therapy to Cytotoxic Therapy in Advanced Cancer Care Using Real World Data: How to Avoid Design Choices That Generate Immortal Time
papers.authors: Garcia-Albeniz X, Vila-Guilera J, Zamparini M, Oliveres H, Alonso-Orduna V, Feliu J
papers.abstract:
BACKGROUND: Since real-world data lack information on treatment assignment (usually the only information available is treatment prescription/administration) and early outcomes can happen in advanced cancer, some design choices may introduce immortal time due to selection or due to treatment strategy misclassification.
OBJECTIVE: To illustrate design choices that would biassedly introduce immortal time and propose unbiased alternatives, using as a case study the estimation of the effects of different monoclonal antibody (mAb) sequencing strategies on overall survival in colorectal cancer patients.
METHODS: We specified a target trial to estimate the effect on overall survival of initiating mAb within 8 weeks of starting first line chemotherapy versus initiating mAb with second line chemotherapy. The first biased design choice would be requiring the initiation of second line chemotherapy for eligibility. This was avoided by aligning eligibility with the initiation of first line chemotherapy. The second biased design choice would be excluding from the first line mAb strategy those who die during the grace period without starting mAb. This was avoided separately via cloning, censoring and weighting and by sequential emulation.
RESULTS: There were 1014 eligible patients in GEMCAD 1401. The CCW approach estimated a 4-year survival difference (second-first line mAb) of 4.3% (95% CI) (-3.3%; 10.0%) and a risk ratio (RR) of 0.95 (0.88; 1.04). Sequential trial emulation estimated a survival difference of -2.8% (-7.5%; 1.2%) and a RR of 1.04 (0.98; 1.10). Biased analyses that introduced immortal time estimated an implausible early survival benefit for mAb initiation with second-line (6-month RR of 0.13 (0.03; 0.28)).
CONCLUSIONS: Our results are compatible with no effect on survival by mAb sequencing. Misalignment of time zero, treatment assignment, and eligibility introduced immortal time.
papers.title_zh: 在真實世界數據中研究晚期癌症何時加入生物治療於化學治療：如何避免產生「不死時間」的設計選擇
papers.abstract_zh:
背景：由於真實世界數據缺乏治療分派的資訊（通常僅能取得治療處方/給藥資訊），且晚期癌症可能發生早期結果事件，某些設計選擇可能因選擇偏誤或治療策略誤分類而引入「不死時間（immortal time）」。

目的：以評估大腸直腸癌病患中不同單株抗體（mAb）序列策略對整體存活的影響為案例，說明會產生偏誤性不死時間的設計選擇，並提出無偏誤的替代方案。

方法：我們設定一個目標試驗（target trial），評估於第一線化療開始後8週內啟動mAb，相較於第二線化療時才啟動mAb，對整體存活的影響。第一個有偏誤的設計選擇是要求以啟動第二線化療作為納入條件——此偏誤透過將納入條件與第一線化療起始點對齊來避免。第二個有偏誤的設計選擇是將在寬限期內未啟動mAb即死亡者排除於第一線mAb策略組之外——此偏誤分別透過克隆（cloning）、審查（censoring）與加權（weighting），以及序列性模擬（sequential emulation）來避免。

結果：GEMCAD 1401研究中共有1014名符合條件之病患。CCW方法估計4年存活差異（第二線減第一線mAb）為4.3%（95% CI -3.3%; 10.0%），風險比（RR）為0.95（0.88; 1.04）。序列性試驗模擬估計存活差異為-2.8%（-7.5%; 1.2%），RR為1.04（0.98; 1.10）。引入不死時間的偏誤分析則估計出一個不合理的早期mAb第二線啟動存活益處（6個月RR為0.13（0.03; 0.28））。

結論：我們的結果與mAb序列對存活無影響的假設一致。時間零點、治療分派與納入條件的錯位會引入不死時間。

papers.action: 目前不需改變外科做法；此為腫瘤內科用藥時序及真實世界數據方法學議題，非手術決策範疇。

papers.title: Characterization of human isogenic epithelial cell lines as a relevant tool to study colon carcinogenesis and interactions between genes and environment
papers.journal_full: Food and chemical toxicology : an international journal published for the British Industrial Biological Research Association
papers.authors: Tête A, Arnaud L, Le Mentec H, Poupin N, Gallais I, Tournadre N
papers.abstract: Colorectal cancer, the third most common cancer worldwide, represents a major public health challenge. While only 5-10% of cases are linked to inherited genetic mutations, environmental factors play a crucial role. Epidemiological evidence suggests that diet alone may account for 30-70% of cases, making it a primary source of exposure to environmental contaminants in the colon. The disease develops progressively through the accumulation of genetic alterations, including loss of tumor suppressor gene function (APC and TP53) and activation of the proto-oncogene K-Ras. Understanding the complex interactions between genetic predisposition and environmental exposures requires advanced experimental models. In this study, we characterized an in vitro model using a non-malignant human colonic epithelial cell line and its isogenic derivatives carrying key mutations associated with colorectal cancer. These cell lines mimic the major stages of carcinogenesis: initiation, promotion, and progression. We conducted a comprehensive analysis of their biological properties, including proliferation, migration, clonogenic capacity, apoptosis resistance, and response to genotoxic stress. Additionally, metabolic profiling and xenobiotic response assessments were performed. Multivariate analysis revealed distinct features among the cell lines, providing a robust framework to investigate how environmental factors interact with genetic susceptibility in the development of colorectal cancer.
papers.title_zh: 人類同基因型上皮細胞株之特性分析：作為研究大腸癌致癌機轉與基因-環境交互作用之相關工具
papers.abstract_zh: 大腸直腸癌是全球第三常見的癌症，是重大公共衛生挑戰。僅有5-10%的病例與遺傳性基因突變有關，環境因子扮演關鍵角色。流行病學證據顯示，飲食單獨可能佔30-70%的病例，使其成為大腸中環境污染物暴露的主要來源。此疾病透過基因變異的累積逐漸發展，包括腫瘤抑制基因功能喪失（APC和TP53）以及原致癌基因K-Ras的活化。要理解基因易感性與環境暴露之間複雜的交互作用，需要先進的實驗模型。本研究中，我們使用非惡性人類大腸上皮細胞株及其帶有大腸直腸癌相關關鍵突變的同基因型衍生株，建立並特性化一個體外模型。這些細胞株模擬了致癌過程的主要階段：起始、促進與進展。我們對其生物學特性進行了全面分析，包括增殖、遷移、克隆形成能力、抗凋亡能力，以及對基因毒性壓力的反應。此外，也進行了代謝譜分析與外源物質反應評估。多變量分析揭示了這些細胞株之間的獨特特徵，提供了一個穩健的框架，以研究環境因子如何與基因易感性交互作用，進而影響大腸直腸癌的發展。

papers.title: The dominant role of geriatrics vulnerabilities and comorbidities in readmissions after colorectal surgery: Shifting from "nonmodifiable" to "actionable" risk
papers.authors: Cizginer S, Yildiz F, Cauley C, Bartels S, Deiner S, Lee G
papers.abstract:
BACKGROUND: Unplanned readmission within 30 days following colorectal surgery occurs in up to 20% of older patients (≥65 years), representing a significant clinical and economic burden. Designing effective interventions to reduce readmission depends on whether risk factors are modifiable or actionable. This study identified and categorized the drivers of readmission, with a specific focus on actionable factors.
METHODS: We analyzed data from 49,021 elective colectomy and proctectomy cases aged ≥65 years and discharged home in the National Surgical Quality Improvement Program from 2016 to 2020 using univariate and multivariable logistic regression. We categorized factors associated with readmission in 4 groups: (1) comorbidities, (2) preoperative clinical characteristics and geriatric vulnerabilities, (3) surgical stressors, and (4) postoperative complications before discharge. We restricted our analytic cohort to patients aged ≥65 years who were initially discharged to their home. The primary outcome was a composite of unplanned readmission or 30-day mortality.
RESULTS: Unplanned readmission occurred in 4,569 (9.3%) of this sample; an additional 76 patients (0.2%) died within 30 days without a prior readmission, yielding a composite adverse outcome of 4,645 (9.5%). Among comorbidities, chronic heart failure (strongest predictor) (odds ratio, 1.96; 95% confidence interval, 1.49-2.53), insulin-dependent diabetes (odds ratio, 1.52; 95% confidence interval, 1.35-1.7), and chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (odds ratio, 1.38; 95% confidence interval, 1.23-1.55) were most strongly associated with readmission. Geriatric vulnerabilities included total functional dependence (strongest predictor) (odds ratio, 2.81; 95% confidence interval, 1.24-6.35) and preoperative hypoalbuminemia (<3.0 g/dL; odds ratio, 1.75; 95% confidence interval, 1.47-2.08). Surgical stressors-ostomy creation (odds ratio, 1.83; 95% confidence interval, 1.69-1.99), prolonged operations (>240 minutes; odds ratio, 1.87; 95% confidence interval, 1.71-2.05)-and complications (ileus: odds ratio, 5.56; 95% confidence interval, 5.16-5.98; and acute renal failure: odds ratio, 6.09; 95% confidence interval, 2.82-13.16) also increased risk.
DISCUSSION: Readmissions in older adults reflect the interplay of medical, geriatric, and surgical risks, some of which are modifiable or actionable. A holistic approach that integrates perioperative optimization (eg, malnutrition), proactive comorbidity control (eg, diuretic and insulin management), and tailored postdischarge monitoring and support may mitigate readmission rates.

papers.title_zh: 老年病人共病與老年脆弱性在大腸直腸手術後再入院中的主導角色：從「不可改變」轉向「可介入」的風險
papers.abstract_zh:
背景：大腸直腸手術後30天內非計畫性再入院在老年病人（≥65歲）中發生率高達20%，造成顯著的臨床與經濟負擔。設計有效的降低再入院措施，取決於危險因子是否可改變或可介入。本研究辨識並分類再入院之驅動因子，特別聚焦於可介入因子。

方法：我們分析2016至2020年美國國家外科品質改善計畫（NSQIP）資料庫中49,021例年齡≥65歲、接受選擇性結腸切除或直腸切除且出院回家之病例，使用單變量與多變量邏輯回歸分析。我們將與再入院相關之因子分為四類：（1）共病、（2）術前臨床特徵與老年脆弱性、（3）手術壓力源、（4）出院前之術後併發症。分析族群限於年齡≥65歲且初次出院回家之病人。主要結果為非計畫性再入院或30天死亡率之複合指標。

結果：本樣本中4,569例（9.3%）發生非計畫性再入院；另有76例（0.2%）在未先前再入院之情況下30天內死亡，複合不良結果共4,645例（9.5%）。共病方面，慢性心衰竭（最強預測因子）（勝算比1.96，95%信賴區間1.49-2.53）、胰島素依賴型糖尿病（勝算比1.52，95%信賴區間1.35-1.7）及慢性阻塞性肺病（勝算比1.38，95%信賴區間1.23-1.55）與再入院最強相關。老年脆弱性方面，完全功能依賴（最強預測因子）（勝算比2.81，95%信賴區間1.24-6.35）與術前低白蛋白血症（<3.0 g/dL；勝算比1.75，95%信賴區間1.47-2.08）為重要因子。手術壓力源——造口形成（勝算比1.83，95%信賴區間1.69-1.99）、手術時間延長（>240分鐘；勝算比1.87，95%信賴區間1.71-2.05）——以及併發症（腸阻塞：勝算比5.56，95%信賴區間5.16-5.98；急性腎損傷：勝算比6.09，95%信賴區間2.82-13.16）亦增加風險。

討論：老年人再入院反映醫療、老年及手術風險之相互作用，其中部分是可改變或可介入的。整合圍術期優化（如營養不良）、主動共病管理（如利尿劑與胰島素管理）及量身訂做的出院後監測與支持之全面性方法，可能有助於降低再入院率。
papers.score_reason: 大型多中心資料庫（NSQIP）、樣本量充足且聚焦於可介入因子分類，對台灣術後品質改善與出院準備規劃具實用價值，但仍屬觀察性研究無法確立因果。
papers.relevance_why: 直接針對大腸直腸手術老年病人之再入院危險因子，可用於臨床風險分層與出院照護規劃。
papers.one_liner: 在49,021名≥65歲大腸直腸手術病人中，分析再入院/死亡危險因子，發現功能依賴(OR2.81)、腸阻塞(OR5.56)、急性腎損傷(OR6.09)最強相關。
papers.action: 術前加強白蛋白與功能狀態評估，術後密切監測腸阻塞與腎功能，並優先安排高風險（心衰竭、造口、手術>240分）老年病人之出院後追蹤。

pico.P: 49,021名年齡≥65歲、接受選擇性結腸切除或直腸切除且出院回家之病人（NSQIP資料庫，2016-2020）
pico.I: 多項風險因子（共病、老年脆弱性、手術壓力源、術後併發症）之存在
pico.C: 無對照組（單一族群內以邏輯回歸比較有無各風險因子）
pico.O: 主要：30天非計畫性再入院或死亡之複合結果；次要：各分類危險因子之個別勝算比

key_numbers: 整體非計畫再入院率9.3%，加計死亡後複合不良結果達9.5%
術後急性腎損傷OR 6.09（95% CI 2.82-13.16）與腸阻塞OR 5.56（95% CI 5.16-5.98）為最強再入院預測因子
完全功能依賴OR 2.81但95% CI極寬(1.24-6.35)，顯示估計值不穩定
cautions: 回溯性資料庫研究僅顯示相關性，無法證明改善「可介入」因子後真能降低再入院率
摘要僅提供OR與CI，未提供各因子分組之絕對事件率，無法計算ARR或NNT
完全功能依賴之95% CI過寬(1.24-6.35)，此因子病例數可能過少，估計值不穩定
papers.context: 前作發現≥80歲病人手術時間≥250分鐘增加術後嚴重併發症風險(OR 1.966)；本篇在≥65歲更大族群中，同樣確認手術時間>240分鐘為再入院之危險因子(OR 1.87)，並進一步將老年脆弱性、共病與術後併發症系統性分類，補充了「可介入因子」的完整風險圖譜。
